exit 0
--- stdout
h1 GET /a/b: 200 a/b
h1 GET /a%2Fb: 404 {"error":"not found"}
h1 POST /up/a/b: 200 stream a/b 5 bytes
h1 POST /up/a%2Fb: 200 up {f}=a/b 5 bytes
h2c GET /a/b: 200 a/b
h2c GET /a%2Fb: 404 {"error":"not found"}
h2c POST /up/a/b: 200 stream a/b 5 bytes
h2c POST /up/a%2Fb: 200 up {f}=a/b 5 bytes
done
